messages:
Lina (Solutions): Heads-up — customer (GlobalFin) just asked for BYOK with automatic HSM failover across us-east1 / eu-west1 / ap-southeast1. They want POC to validate key rotation + cross-region failover, and a pricing breakdown for reserved vs burst usage.
Emma (Sales): Noted. Are they asking for FIPS-compliant HSMs? Legal will need that on the contract.
Lina (Solutions): Yes, they specified FIPS 140-2 Level 3 and SOC2. Also want audit log export to their SIEM.
Mohit (Eng): Technically doable. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Active-active replicated keys or passive standby with async sync? 2) Rotation validation — customer-driven rotate or platform-initiated?
Lina (Solutions): They want to drive rotation from their KMS (customer-managed) and see seamless failover with zero downtime. Also want local KV cache TTL controls so stale wrapped keys don't persist.
Jordan (Security): @Mohit please check our HSM SKUs for FIPS certs. We also need to document the key-wrapping handshake for BYOK and get their HSM attestation.
Ashley (SRE): For the POC we can spin a 2-node HSM pair per region in Dedicated. Runbook note: we need a 48h lead time for on-demand HSM provisioning.
Emma (Sales): Pricing question from the buyer: do we bill multi-region HSM usage as HSM-hours or flat reserved monthly? They asked for concrete numbers to show procurement.
Mohit (Eng): Typical options: a) Reserved capacity per region (monthly commit), b) Pay-as-you-go (HSM-hour), c) Hybrid reserved baseline + burst HSM-hours. For POC we usually offer 2 weeks of trial credits + discounted HSM-hour rate.
Emma (Sales): Can we put a hard cap on charges during the POC to avoid surprises?
Ashley (SRE): Yes — we can enforce per-project quotas and burst throttles. We'll record a hard cap in the SOW and lock billing alerts. :thumbsup:
Lina (Solutions): Action items: Mohit — estimate effort for rotation harness + failover test (hours). Jordan — list attestation docs + whether external auditor required. Ashley — confirm provisioning lead time for 3 regions. Emma — I'll draft POC SOW with acceptance criteria and billing cap.
Mohit (Eng): Est: 5 dev days for rotation harness + test scripts, 2 infra days for provisioning and runbook. Perf note: expect ~20–40ms latency bump during key swap if cache TTL=30s.
Jordan (Security): Attestation list: HSM certs, FIPS report, SOC2 Type II summary, key ceremony notes, KMS handshake diagram. External audit not required for POC but legal may ask for additional evidence.
Emma (Sales): Customer also asked about rotation cadence and emergency rollback options — they're proposing 30-day rotates for the POC.
Lina (Solutions): For rollback we can snapshot wrapped key material under their CMK and provide a secure retrieval channel. We'll rehearse rollback in the acceptance tests.
deploy-bot: new deploy started by @Ashley (SRE) — provisioning hsm-dedicated-001 in us-east1 (ETA 36h)
Emma (Sales): I'll send a POC kickoff invite for next Tue, include acceptance criteria: 1) successful rotation initiated by customer KMS, 2) cross-region failover with <1m RTO, 3) audit export into SIEM, 4) billing cap enforced.
Lina (Solutions): Thanks — I'll add the test checklist and sample scripts to the POC repo (link in invite).
Mohit (Eng): I'll prep the rotation harness and share a short demo plan.
Jordan (Security): Send me the customer's attestations as soon as they share them; I'll pre-check our doc pack.
Emma (Sales): Great. Closing thread for now, will follow-up with the SOW draft and calendar invite. :v:
